observations: Three photos show a metal filing cabinet with three drawers.
The cabinet has a grey top and sides, with light greenish-grey drawer fronts.
Each drawer has a silver handle and a label holder.
The top surface is heavily scratched and worn, with visible paint chipping.
The cabinet is outdoors, placed on concrete, next to other similar cabinets and covered items.
Photo 2 shows a different cabinet with white drawers and sides, possibly a different unit or a different angle with lighting affecting color perception.
No brand or model is visible on any part of the cabinet in any photo.
The cabinet appears to be made of metal, likely steel, with visible rivets or fasteners on the sides.

Photos show wear and tear; 'perfect' is subjective and not visually confirmed.
